_notes.slope_layer: REAL DATA — slope zone polygons (layer_type: 'slope') derived from USGS/SRTMGL1_003 (SRTM 30m DEM) via Google Earth Engine. Classified into Flat/Gentle/Moderate/Steep by degree thresholds, majority-filtered and vectorized (largest zones retained per watershed, capped for file size). Source: NASA/USGS SRTM. Resolution: 30m native (vectorized at ~90m grid). Processing: Google Earth Engine, ee.Terrain.slope + reduceToVectors.
